name: What is the process for adding home automation to a renovation with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for adding home automation to a renovation with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an in-depth consultation where we discuss your lifestyle, needs, and desired level of home automation during the initial design phase of your larger renovation project. Our design-build team then develops a comprehensive plan, incorporating smart technologies into the architectural and interior designs. We manage the procurement, installation, and programming of all systems, coordinating seamlessly with the construction schedule, and conducting a final walkthrough to ensure complete satisfaction with the integrated solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process integrates home automation from initial design consultation, through planning and installation, to a final walkthrough, as part of your larger renovation project.
